source.title: Synthesis of coronary 4D CT image by denoising diffusion probabilistic model
source.venue: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine 282, 109382 (2026)
source.figure: Fig. 8. Visualized CFD results for Case 1: pressure and wall shear stress profiles during the whole period (Phase 0–9)
source.frames_from: authors' figure deck (Figure for 4DCT.pptx), same renders as Fig. 8 at 1036×782

notes: Phase 0 and Phase 5 are the two acquired CT phases (end-diastole and end-systole); phases 1–4 and 6–9 are synthesized by the diffusion deformable model and then solved with CFD.
Reported in the paper: PSNR 32.01, SSIM 0.937, Dice 0.973, 4D CT-FFR accuracy 90.5 % against invasive FFR (abstract).
